description: blueteam.ee's rules for fabric-pr arm. boundary.paths: the site is an Astro build over pre-built Landkit bundles, installed with npm and deployed by hand-uploading dist/ to an i-MSCP host, so its boundary is the manifests and lockfile that decide what installs and runs (package.json, package-lock.json, .npmrc), the build configuration (astro.config.*, tsconfig*.json, which load plugins and code at build time), the harness wiring (.claude/: settings, hooks, commands), the ignore file that keeps .env out of a commit (.env*, .gitignore), CI (.github/, none today), any deployment script (deploy*, upload*), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, key, auth). boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/: Markdown prose, src/content/ and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary.

direct.description: Direct to main: brand-comms commits copy, content, pages, components, styles, fonts and images straight to main (the owner, 2026-10-10). By pull request: what decides what installs, builds, deploys or runs (the manifests, lockfiles and .npmrc, astro.config.* and tsconfig*.json, other *.config.* and tool-version files, Makefile/Dockerfile, wrangler/netlify/vercel and public/_headers and _redirects), the harness wiring (.claude/, .mcp.json), CI, hooks, the deploy and upload scripts, .env* and .gitignore, every script (shell, Python, Ruby, Perl, PowerShell, and JavaScript or TypeScript outside src/, vendor bundles under public/ included, and anything under bin/, scripts/ or tools/), any file whose git mode is executable, and secret-shaped names (secret, credential, api key, auth token, private key, password, .pem/.p12/.pfx/.key). Styles, design tokens, fonts, images, content and pages are direct.
